name: Jeeter Quad Infused Preroll | Double Rainbow
description: Double Rainbow is a sweet and fruity indica with a complex flavor profile. The dry hit presents a mixture of sweet berries with a mango sour finish, followed by a smooth berry sweetness on the inhale. The exhale leans fruity with a subtle sour undertone, adding depth to the experience. Relaxing and smooth, Double Rainbow is perfect for unwinding and adding a touch of sweetness to your day.
